name: drive-sonar-linux-dev
postCreateCommand: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y libwebkit2gtk-4.1-dev libgtk-3-dev libayatana-appindicator3-dev librsvg2-dev pkg-config build-essential libssl-dev && curl -L https://github.com/mozilla/sccache/releases/latest/download/sccache-v0.8.2-x86_64-unknown-linux-musl.tar.gz | tar xz -C /tmp && sudo mv /tmp/sccache-*/sccache /usr/local/bin/
